tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ensure uninterrupted power with the Marsriva MP10 1000W Portable Power Station. Featuring a high-capacity LiFePO4 battery and pure sine wave AC output, this powerful yet portable unit is perfect for home backup, outdoor adventures, and emergency situations. With multiple output options — AC outlets, DC ports, USB-A, USB-C, and a 12V cigarette lighter socket — you can charge laptops, phones, mini-fridges, fans, and other essential devices simultaneously. It supports solar panel and car charging, as well as UPS functionality for seamless power during outages. Built with safety protections and a long battery lifespan of 4000+ cycles, the MP10 delivers reliable energy wherever you need it.


Key Features:


  • Power Output: 1000W continuous, 2000W peak for small appliances and electronics
  • Battery Type: LiFePO4 high-capacity battery (~1176Wh / 48V) for extended runtime
  • Pure Sine Wave AC Output: Safe for sensitive electronics
  • Multiple Output Ports: Dual AC outlets, DC 5521, USB-A, USB-C, 12V car port
  • Solar & Car Charging Compatible: Charge via solar panels or car for off-grid use
  • UPS Functionality: Automatic switch-on during power outage ensures uninterrupted energy
  • Long Lifespan & Safety: 4000+ cycles, with overcharge, over-discharge, and short-circuit protection
  • Portable & Durable: Compact, easy to carry, and suitable for home, camping, or emergency use
